newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai CITS Sets Cash Dividend.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai CITS Sets Cash Dividend.

text.p: Shanghai China International Travel Service Co Ltd (SCITS) has fixed a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.20 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the Shanghai Securities News reported on Saturday.
The ex-dividend day is June 24, and the dividend will be calculated for foreign exchange B share holders at 8.2923 yuan to the dollar, the newspaper said.
SCITS reported a 1996 net profit of 43.455 million yuan based on international accounting standards, up 10.25 percent from 39.416 million yuan in 1995.
Based on domestic accounting standards, the 1996 net profit was 44.375 million yuan against 41.067 million yuan in 1995.
